data.comment:
# Comfy Grok Imagine Video 1.5- Image to Video

Upload an image and optional text prompt to generate a video with native audio, realistic motion, and high-quality output up to 720p resolution. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_imagine_video_1_5.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Cinematic 4K slow video, almost static camera with extremely slow dolly out. The cybernetic nun is in close profile view, hands clasped in prayer, face lit by sparkling light particles, white habit and glowing halo. She sits in a minimalist, all-white room with a large, simple window directly behind her. The camera barely moves, slowly pulling back just enough to reveal the window frame and the soft futuristic cityscape beyond: sleek glowing buildings, subtle light streams, and a calm, hazy sky. No fast movement, serene and intimate mood, soft volumetric lighting, photorealistic sci-fi
